top_signals.title: Crude oil prices and refinery margins generally increased throughout the third quarter
top_signals.summary: Petroleum markets in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26) were characterized by increasing prices for crude oil and petroleum products amid persistent conflict in the Middle East.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: EU drops push for global ban on Arctic drilling
top_signals.summary: Brussels’ new strategy excludes 2021 pledge to work towards a ‘multilateral legal obligation’ not to allow any further hydrocarbon development in the polar region

top_signals.title: Walmart Sells US Debt, Eyes Canadian Market as Spending Grows
top_signals.summary: Walmart Inc. is selling US dollar bonds for a second time this year and sounding out investors for a debut Canadian debt offering as the world’s largest retailer seeks to diversify its funding sources amid a spending spree.

top_signals.title: Chancellor says ‘It is my job to protect resilience of the UK economy and the budget will do that’ in the face of international headwinds
top_signals.summary: Chancellor of the Exchequer, John Healey used the IMF Annual Meetings in Bangkok to set out how the UK and its international partners can work together to respond to global economic headwinds and strengthen the conditions for growth.

top_signals.title: Inside a Packaging Industry Mega-Deal
top_signals.summary: Silgan is teaming up with American Industrial Partners to acquire Trivium Packaging in a deal valued at about $3.4 billion dollars.  Silgan President and CEO Adam J. Greenlee discusses the strategic fit, expected benefits for shareholders and what the deal says about consumer demand and the broader economy. (Source: Bloomberg)
